anchor.prompt: A cinematic workshop master still at night, painterly-photorealistic: a scarred aged-limewood workbench centered beneath one green-black metal tungsten task lamp, hand tools and brass calipers on the left, linen, wax, string spools and curled wood shavings, a narrow shelf of finished wooden figures receding at camera right, deep umber room beyond. At the center sits one refined adult feminine marionette with a softly oval pale-limewood face, straight dark-chestnut bob, warm hazel glass eyes, slender adult proportions and articulated aged-brass joints, calm and handcrafted rather than uncanny. The puppet is the single warm luminous subject. Adult craftsperson hands are absent. Rich protected blacks, warm parchment highlights, dust motes in the lamp cone, gentle halation, tactile wood pores and oxidized brass, reverent 40 mm large-format composition, subtle depth of field, soft cinematic film grain. Keep the complete puppet, lamp, bench landmarks and shelf inside the center half of the landscape frame. Inviting artisan workshop, never sinister. No readable text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, wordmarks, UI, captions, watermarks, people, children, horror, creepy doll styling, gore, franchise characters, melted objects, or duplicate puppets. 16:9 landscape composition.

frames.scene: The same workshop is mostly dark. One plain shipping crate sits centered on the bench, all stencil marks completely sanded away. The crate's cast shadow clearly resembles one slumped humanoid figure inside before the lid opens. A brass pry bar is just slipping under the lid. Frustrating mystery, never horror.
frames.camera: 40 mm slow-push landing, low eye level.

frames.scene: A beautiful but darker borrowed wooden marionette is pulled upright from the open crate on grey strings; its shoulder, elbow and knee joints are visibly mismatched sizes. On the wall, its single shadow holds a clearly different but non-threatening pose. It ends hanging from the central test frame with a slight sway.
frames.camera: 50 mm rising composition with puppet and shadow both centered.

frames.scene: Macro view across the borrowed puppet's grey control strings as the control bar turns; strings cross into an impossible over-under knot and one arm points opposite the pull. The knot has tightened into a compact fist shape, with the puppet readable behind it.
frames.camera: 65 mm macro lateral drift landing.

frames.scene: The borrowed marionette is rigid in a clean arms-out T-pose above the bench while every grey string hangs visibly slack. Adult hands behind the control bar pull without effect. The lamp has just begun one restrained flicker. The failure reads technical and frustrating, not frightening.
frames.camera: Near-static 58 mm centered slight-push landing.

frames.scene: Under the steady tungsten lamp, a distinct horizontal tide line has climbed from the borrowed puppet's feet nearly to its head, leaving matte neutral-grey clay below and the last warm wood color above. The full puppet and the color boundary are centered and legible.
frames.camera: Locked 70 mm craft close-up.

frames.scene: Extreme macro of one borrowed puppet eye: a flat painted iris on wood with no glass depth and no specular highlight. The swinging lamp makes highlights move across surrounding varnish and brass, but the painted eye remains visibly flat. The puppet is being lowered face-down beyond focus.
frames.camera: 90 mm macro, humane technical detail.

frames.scene: An adult hand opens a shallow workshop drawer containing neatly separated broken wooden limbs, tangled grey spools and mismatched hands. Forced perspective makes the orderly drawer appear impossibly deeper than the bench, but it is a repair archive, not a torture scene. Dust has just jumped from the closing edge.
frames.camera: Overhead 45 mm push landing inside the drawer.

frames.scene: The bench is swept completely clear by two adult hands, leaving one clean pale-limewood block centered under the lamp. Its natural grain faintly suggests the same hero's softly oval face in profile. One fine carving knife has just been picked up at frame edge. Reverent, hopeful stable poster.
frames.camera: Symmetrical 40 mm FLF anchor.

frames.scene: Macro of an adult hand guiding a fine carving knife through the same pale-limewood block. One long fresh curl falls from the blade; on its inner face are tiny abstract photographic tonal shapes like wordless film ribbon. The hero face is only roughly emerging.
frames.camera: 85 mm macro on blade and curl.

frames.scene: A small soft-focus anonymous portrait photograph is pinned above the bench; no identifiable facial detail and no writing. Brass calipers span from photo silhouette to the partly carved pale-limewood profile. The calipers' shadow tips touch the photo cheek while the carved profile matches it.
frames.camera: 50 mm lateral landing showing photograph and carving together.

frames.scene: An adult thumb smooths one thin warm skin-toned translucent leaf from the center across the carved hero face. The leaf visibly dissolves into the wood rather than wrapping it; the softly oval face is flesh-toned while the neck remains bare pale limewood.
frames.camera: 70 mm macro following the thumb-stroke direction.

frames.scene: Two physical lit skin swatches slide together beneath the lamp: anonymous photograph-cheek tone on one side and hero-puppet cheek tone on the other. Their center dividing line has almost vanished into one continuous measured tone. No charts, labels or numbers.
frames.camera: Locked 90 mm macro with both swatches centered.

frames.scene: A narrow brush of warm light encircles the hero's articulated neck ring as the material seam finishes fading. The seam itself is gone, but its shadow lingers one beat as a thin lifted ribbon. The completed head has begun a free natural turn.
frames.camera: 60 mm close orbit landing a few degrees around the neck.

frames.scene: Two warm hazel glass eyes are seated in the hero's softly oval face. The single tungsten highlight lands inside both eyes; each tiny reflection shows the same finished puppet silhouette before the body is finished. The gaze is calm and handcrafted, never uncanny.
frames.camera: 85 mm push landing at eye line.

frames.scene: Adult hands use one fine comb to lay the hero's straight dark-chestnut hair in deliberate strand groups. Candle-thin strand shadows settle behind the comb; the completed head glows under the lamp with light passing through clean hair edges.
frames.camera: Slow 70 mm arc landing over the crown.

frames.scene: A small wordless garment reference photograph is pinned above the bench. As adult scissors open below, one real linen garment panel pours from the image onto the bench, leaving the photo visually empty. The cloth is practical tailored fabric, not magical smoke.
frames.camera: 50 mm tilt landing from wall to centered fabric pieces.

frames.scene: Adult hands pin a fitted linen-and-brass outfit onto the same articulated hero body while the brass joints flex naturally. A mirror behind the bench shows the correct back of the outfit, though the front is toward camera. The dressed hero stands upright on the central stand.
frames.camera: 55 mm lateral landing with puppet and mirror both readable.

frames.scene: Stable hero poster: the same dressed puppet stands centered while one wardrobe rail behind her displays EXACTLY EIGHT distinct empty outfits, all fully separated and countable, no ninth garment and no loose extra cloth. Each outfit's shadow shows the same hero wearing it. Keep all eight complete outfits inside the center half for portrait crop.
frames.camera: 35 mm centered lateral-track landing, FLF anchor.

frames.scene: Warm strings made only of light descend and attach cleanly at the hero's wrists, knees and head, bending and swaying like real thread. Adult hands receive one aged-brass control bar. The light strings are the single luminous accent.
frames.camera: 45 mm crane-down landing with all attachments centered.

frames.scene: Adult hands tilt the brass control bar and the hero's right arm rises precisely as intended. Her single wall shadow mirrors the pose perfectly and at the same instant, clearly answering Act I. The arm is settling while the head lifts.
frames.camera: 50 mm two-shot landing with puppet and obedient shadow.

frames.scene: Macro of the hero's pale-limewood chest as its grain flexes through one subtle slow breath. Dust motes form one brief ring in the tungsten cone and begin to disperse. Warm hazel eye-gleam appears softly above, calm rather than alive-human.
frames.camera: Static 85 mm chest macro.

frames.scene: The decisive stable poster: adult hands close one pair of aged-brass scissors through ALL luminous control strings in a single clean stroke above the centered hero. Every severed string rises upward and dissolves into warm sparks. The same hero stands alone and balanced below, fully unstrung, no injury or violence.
frames.camera: 40 mm push-through landing, FLF killshot anchor.

frames.scene: The unstrung hero takes one confident first step from the stand onto the bench, articulated brass joints clean and mechanically plausible. A warm source-less spotlight follows only her as the dark workshop watches. She is headed toward the bench's far end.
frames.camera: 35 mm low bench-level tracking landing.

frames.scene: The same scarred bench grain stretches seamlessly into a long road while the workshop recedes; bench-edge rails become road rails without a cut or moving parts. The walking hero remains centered. Four faint colored glows stand far ahead.
frames.camera: 30 mm pullback that lands as a follow shot.

frames.scene: Stable wide poster: EXACTLY FOUR distinct doorframes stand along the dark bench-road, all fully inside the center half. Door one leaks cold marble daylight; door two leaks emerald-teal ocean-sky glow; door three leaks warm low-poly jungle light; door four leaks dusk artillery amber. Their four pools fuse into one continuous gradient. The hero faces door one.
frames.camera: Single 40 mm lateral-track landing, FLF anchor.

frames.scene: The same hero walks through the first frame into a photoreal pale-marble hall under harsh honest daylight. Skin tone, chestnut hair and linen cloth remain true and tactile. Her polished-floor reflection briefly takes the anonymous photograph's silhouette.
frames.camera: 45 mm orbit landing as she walks deeper.

frames.scene: Extreme honest daylight macro of the same hero: fine skin finish over limewood, individual chestnut strand shadows, linen weave and aged-brass joints all hold true. A hard light sweep has crossed almost 180 degrees without any surface turning grey, waxy or broken.
frames.camera: Locked 90 mm macro, light-driven landing.

frames.scene: The same hero crosses door two into an emerald-teal arena above open ocean with floating stone islands. Exactly at the doorframe her rendering shifts slightly toward refined toon shading while face, bob, proportions and brass joints remain identical. She lands on one island platform.
frames.camera: 40 mm follow-through landing, deep teal near #117E6A.

frames.scene: The toon-restyled but identical hero is captured in one clean leap between emerald-teal sky islands. Her shadow reaches the landing a half-beat early in a playful but obedient echo. The next warm doorway glow awaits beyond the landing.
frames.camera: 35 mm tracking-leap landing with complete body centered.

frames.scene: The same hero passes into a chunky warm low-poly jungle island and becomes cleanly faceted while her same softly oval face and warm hazel eyes still read. Fresh-carved facets catch warm light; parted polygon palms reveal a dirt path and fourth amber glow.
frames.camera: 50 mm push-through landing between palms.

frames.scene: Poster close-up of ONE same hero face split exactly down the nose by a style transition: left half photoreal painterly skin-over-limewood, right half warm faceted low-poly carving. Both hazel eyes align perfectly, the same chestnut bob and facial geometry continue across the seam, no duplicate face.
frames.camera: Symmetrical 85 mm proof-frame landing.

frames.scene: The same hero stands steady on a dusk hill in wind while warm tracer lights arc high overhead. As she looks up, the arcs are frozen briefly into clean dotted diagram curves without labels or weapon logos. Her full figure is calm and centered.
frames.camera: 45 mm rise landing from boots to sky.

frames.scene: The same hero walks back toward camera with all four door colors behind her at once. EXACTLY FOUR distinct shadows lead ahead, fully countable and centered: photoreal crisp, emerald-toon, warm faceted, and long dusk shadow. The workshop bench edge has appeared underfoot.
frames.camera: 40 mm frontal retreat landing.

frames.scene: Back in the same workshop, a long shelf of finished handcrafted figures recedes with mirror-like depth. Each figure casts one distinct non-creepy shadow. Adult hands place the same newest pale-limewood and brass hero among them, centered beneath the lamp.
frames.camera: Patient 50 mm lateral shelf landing, FLF anchor.

frames.scene: The borrowed puppet's old grey strings lie in one tidy coil on the bench with ends cleanly cut; the original crate stands open and empty behind. The tangled coil's cast shadow is one perfectly straight line. Lamp focus begins shifting toward the ledger.
frames.camera: Overhead 60 mm push landing.

frames.scene: A thick workshop ledger opens itself on the bench. Wordless ruled lines, blank seals and abstract woodcut impressions press into parchment; no letters or numbers. Each new impression appears slightly before an unseen press. The page is turning toward one blank entry.
frames.camera: 85 mm macro track landing down the page.

frames.scene: The ledger rests open to a completely blank ruled entry beside one fresh pale-limewood block. The new block's grain faintly suggests a different adult face profile from the hero. Both subjects are centered under the single lamp as the camera begins to rise.
frames.camera: 50 mm twin-subject settle.

frames.scene: High wide view of the same full workshop: central bench, figure shelf, ledger and tool wall. EXACTLY FOUR small lanterns hang over the bench in cold marble white, emerald-teal, warm jungle gold and dusk amber; each light falls only on the shelf figures associated with its world. The tungsten lamp below begins to dim.
frames.camera: 30 mm crane-up stable landing.

frames.scene: The plain arrival crate from KF01 now sits open and neatly packed with finished handcrafted figures, no logos or writing, ready to ship outward. Its cast shadow clearly shows the figures standing upright inside, answering the original slumped shadow. The lid is beginning to lower.
frames.camera: 40 mm push mirroring KF01.

frames.scene: Stable loop poster in the same near-KF01 workshop composition: the green-black tungsten workbench lamp glows beside the same newest hero seated calmly at center, unstrung. She has just turned her head toward the viewer; the surrounding workshop is already near-dark, with one warm hazel eye-gleam prepared to remain after the click. The plain crate sits in deep background.
